mcqs.question: Which of the following correctly describes Aryan Varshney’s achievement in January 2026?
options: He became India’s 92nd Grandmaster after winning the Andranik Margaryan Memorial in Armenia and drawing with Sumbat Lputian for his final norm.
He became India’s 91st Grandmaster after winning the Andranik Margaryan Memorial in Armenia and drawing with Sumbat Lputian for his final norm.
He became India’s 92nd Grandmaster after defeating Sumbat Lputian in the final of the Andranik Margaryan Memorial.
He became India’s 92nd Grandmaster after winning the Andranik Margaryan Memorial in Delhi and securing his final norm.
mcqs.explanation: At 21, Delhi’s Aryan Varshney became India’s 92nd Grandmaster after winning the Andranik Margaryan Memorial in Armenia and drawing with Sumbat Lputian to secure his final norm. The tempting second option is incorrect because the milestone was India’s 92nd Grandmaster, not the 91st.
